scope_note: Historical complete 32-unit selected Declared-Modules-v1 compiler inventory: noble-kernel, noble-contracts and noble-wasm remain domain-core; noble-cli and noble-syndicate remain composition roots. Source-derived nominal declarations, versioned import and explicit bounded host operations, recursive kernel eligibility, Wasm admission/emission and frontend/worker integration introduce authored bodies with OPEN extraction and refinement obligations. The independent typed Wasmtime kernel peer is verification-only outside production. Pinned Aeneas erases core.fmt.Arguments to Unit; formatted-string construction, diagnostic text and naming semantics are an external assumption, not proved by generated Lean, and their authored source bodies remain OPEN. Finite compiled-Wasm DX acceptance provides bounded execution evidence only. Retained M7 strict Lean roots remain separately bound and do not prove nominal source-to-Wasm, host, engine or whole-program refinement. The partial 54-unit candidate file reviews add 253 exact production paths (183 body/open, 2 generated, 68 structural) to reach 6069 reviewed paths (2778 body/open, 2133 generated, 1158 structural); 2284 observed paths remain unreviewed and 105 historical paths are stale. No candidate source-coverage acceptance or proof is claimed.
